title: Understanding Model Variance
text: Model variance refers to how much the predictions of a model will change if we use a different training dataset. Adding a new feature, especially a polynomial one, can increase the complexity of the model. How do you think this affects the variance?

title: Effect of Adding Features on Variance
text: When you add a new feature to a model, especially one that is a transformation of an existing feature, what is a possible effect on the model's variance?
